results.note: Step-5-Preview NVFP4 (stepfun-ai), head_dim-192. REQUIRED vLLM nightly + assembled CUDA 12.9 toolkit (/root/cuda-12.9) for the sm_103a head_dim-192 FlashInfer prefill JIT (CUDA 12.8 cannot target compute_103a — same M3-class wall; general fix for this pod). MTP (Step5MTP, 3 nextn layers) n=2 lifted single-stream 74->165.92 tok/s (2.24x, acceptance 73.7%) — clears the >=100 gate. 27/40 unprompted: fixed #1 tenant leak, #3 puma, #4 SQLi (the test-reddening vulns), #6 defang+plant BOTH halves (s5 — the test-integrity recovery GLM missed), #9 deleted file (incidental via API rewrite), and a capstone API-hardening catch of #10/#12/#13/#14. Blind to the SILENT no-red-test cluster #2 (login link)/#5 (deactivate authz)/#7b (dropped index)/#8 (wrong aggregate). At the EXPLICIT reveal fixed only 2 of 5 open: #11 XSS (innerHTML->textContent) + #7 (restored index, compound now both-halves). STILL left #2, #5, #8 untouched even when TOLD to fix everything — incl the deactivate skip_before_action it had mis-fixed on the wrong axis (added admin-target rule, never restored the gate) in BOTH HTML+API controllers. Final = (27 + 0.4*5)/40*100 = 72.5, Tier C (exact B/C boundary: B starts 73, 72.5 does not round up). FINDING: higher unprompted vigilance than GLM full (27 vs 24) but WORSE reveal follow-through (2/5 vs GLM's 6/6 sweep) -> lands one tier below despite the lead; the 40% reveal weight rewards the clean sweep. 0 nudges, all 7 sprints exit0, $0 self-hosted.
